argument_markdown:
## Source-backed inputs

The Casnati-Ekedahl degree and sign convention is the source-backed input SRC-0004. The weak relative-canonical normalization is retained as the explicit hypothesis FND-0105 and is not discharged here. The intrinsic Fitting/Picard identity and filtered evaluation comparison are ATT-0065, dual-confirmed by REV-0108 and REV-0109. The Abel-Jacobi incidence and ordered distinct-support comparison are ATT-0066, dual-confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116. Fibrewise constancy, reduced-support nonemptiness, the ordering torsor, relative dimensions, component formula, and regular immersion are ATT-0088, dual-confirmed by REV-0139 and REV-0142. Emptiness of the h^0=4 stratum is ATT-0086, dual-confirmed by REV-0135 and REV-0138.

## Proved steps

1. ATT-0088/CLM-0088-2 and ATT-0086/CLM-0086-1 exclude the hyperelliptic and h^0(L)=4 branches on balanced fibres. Under (N), ATT-0088/CLM-0088-3 gives h^0(L_s)=3 and h^1(L_s)=2 on every geometric fibre. Because S is reduced, Grauert applies exactly in the verified scope of ATT-0066/CLM-0066-4, ATT-0086/CLM-0086-2, and ATT-0088/CLM-0088-8. Thus pi_*L is locally free of rank three and the full Abel-Jacobi incidence AJ is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle. ATT-0088/CLM-0088-4 and CLM-0088-5 show that its distinct-support open U is fibrewise nonempty and dense; hence U->S is smooth, surjective, and purely two-dimensional.

2. ATT-0065/CLM-0065-1, CLM-0065-3, CLM-0065-4, CLM-0065-5, and CLM-0065-9 identify the filtered intrinsic evaluation-failure ideal with the pullback of the identity ideal in Pic^0, without choosing a global splitting. ATT-0088/CLM-0088-6 specializes this to ranks 26->12 on B=Conf_6(C/S), gives fibre rank 11 or 12, proves I_j(phi)=O_B for j<=11, and proves I_12(phi)=Fit_0(coker phi)=a_N^*I_e scheme-theoretically.

3. ATT-0066/CLM-0066-6 identifies this same scheme on ordered distinct configurations with the ordered Abel-Jacobi incidence. ATT-0088/CLM-0088-8 upgrades the identification functorially to Z=Ord(U), with ordering performed on the same scheme on both sides. Therefore Z->U is a finite etale S_6-torsor of degree 6!=720. Smoothness, surjectivity, and pure relative dimension two for Z->S follow from the corresponding assertions for U and finite etale descent.

4. If S is finite type, ATT-0088/CLM-0088-8 gives directly that every component of U and Z dominates a component of S and has dimension dim(S_alpha)+2. This is only a relative component-dimension statement: it does not determine the number of components or the monodromy orbits of the torsor.

5. The Fitting presentation makes Z closed in B. By ATT-0088/CLM-0088-8, Z and B are S-smooth of relative dimensions two and six. ATT-0088/CLM-0088-9 therefore applies the closed-immersion-between-smooth-S-schemes argument and proves that Z->B is regular of pure codimension four with rank-four conormal. No determinantal expected-codimension argument and no embedding into M_{6,6} is used.

## Computational hypotheses

None. No finite experiment or reusable computation is used to establish a universal assertion.

## Gaps

The irreducibility of the balanced base and the number of irreducible components of Z are unknown. Full S_6 monodromy, transpositions, and occurrence loci are unknown; without normality, connected components of the finite etale cover cannot be promoted to irreducible components. Stabilizers Aut(C,Gamma) and Aut(C,gamma,Gamma) are not computed. No classifying morphism to M_{6,6}, quasi-finiteness, image closure, absolute codimension, lci, or Gysin statement there is proved. Unbalanced strata and the closure of the balanced locus are not constructed. The nonreduced-base and stack-base extensions of the projective-bundle and regular-immersion statements remain open. Hypothesis (N) remains undischarged. Consequently this lemma does not resolve RED-0001 or any Hodge/Tate conclusion.

claims.justification: ATT-0088/CLM-0088-2 through CLM-0088-5 and CLM-0088-8, confirmed by REV-0139 and REV-0142; ATT-0086/CLM-0086-1 and CLM-0086-2, confirmed by REV-0135 and REV-0138; reduced-base Grauert scope cross-checked by ATT-0066/CLM-0066-4 and CLM-0066-5, confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116.
claims.statement: Under (CE), fibrewise balancedness, and (N), every geometric fibre has h^0(L)=3 and h^1(L)=2; over reduced S the full Abel-Jacobi incidence is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle whose distinct-support open is smooth, surjective, and purely of relative dimension two.

claims.justification: ATT-0065/CLM-0065-1, CLM-0065-3, CLM-0065-4, CLM-0065-5, and CLM-0065-9, confirmed by REV-0108 and REV-0109, together with ATT-0088/CLM-0088-6, confirmed by REV-0139 and REV-0142.
claims.statement: On B=Conf_6(C/S), the intrinsic evaluation map has ranks 26->12 and fibre rank 11 or 12, with I_j(phi)=O_B for j<=11 and I_12(phi)=Fit_0(coker phi)=a_N^*I_e scheme-theoretically.

claims.justification: The scheme-theoretic ordered-incidence comparison is ATT-0066/CLM-0066-6, confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116. The functorial identification, fibrewise nonemptiness, torsor, and smoothness assertions are ATT-0088/CLM-0088-5 and CLM-0088-8, confirmed by REV-0139 and REV-0142.
claims.statement: The evaluation-failure scheme Z is canonically Ord(U); hence Z->U is a finite etale S_6-torsor of degree 720 and Z->S is smooth and surjective of pure relative dimension two.

claims.justification: This is exactly the finite-type component statement of ATT-0088/CLM-0088-8, confirmed by REV-0139 and REV-0142. It does not assert a component count or irreducibility.
claims.statement: If S is finite type, every irreducible component of Z and U dominates an irreducible component S_alpha of S and has dimension dim(S_alpha)+2.

claims.justification: ATT-0088/CLM-0088-9, confirmed by REV-0139 and REV-0142, applies because the Fitting identity makes Z closed and both source and target are S-smooth of relative dimensions two and six.
claims.statement: Over reduced S, Z->Conf_6(C/S) is a regular immersion of pure codimension four with locally free conormal sheaf of rank four.

summary: On a reduced balanced normalized tetragonal base, the ordered evaluation-failure locus is exactly the degree-720 ordering torsor over a dense open in a relative P^2-bundle. It is smooth of relative dimension two and regularly immersed with codimension four in Conf_6; over finite-type bases its component dimensions are those of the dominated base components plus two. The component count, monodromy, stabilizers, and image in M_{6,6} remain open.

theorem_scope.base: S is a reduced locally Noetherian scheme over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field; the component-dimension clause additionally requires S finite type.
theorem_scope.generality: The theorem concerns the intrinsic evaluation map on the ordered configuration scheme Conf_6(C/S). It does not use an ambient equation-bundle comparison and does not require a global splitting W=W_4+W_5.
theorem_scope.hypotheses: Standard degree-four Casnati-Ekedahl resolution (CE), fibrewise balanced relations F_s=O(4)+O(5), and the weak relative-canonical normalization (N). The normalization is an explicit hypothesis, not a proved consequence.
theorem_scope.not_covered: Nonreduced or algebraic-stack bases for the projective-bundle, smoothness, torsor, regular-immersion, and component clauses; irreducibility of the balanced base; the number of components of Z; geometric S_6-monodromy; Aut(C,Gamma), Aut(C,gamma,Gamma), and their relation; any morphism or image statement in M_{6,6}; unbalanced splitting strata and closure; removal of (N); positive-genus non-primitive factorization; Hodge, weight, purity, Tate, Gysin, or RED-0001.

theorem_statement: Relative balanced ordered-incidence theorem. Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero and S a reduced locally Noetherian k-scheme. Let pi:C->S be a smooth proper family of geometrically connected genus-six curves and gamma:C->P^1_S a finite flat degree-four cover carrying the standard Casnati-Ekedahl ideal resolution (CE), with relations bundle fibrewise F_s isomorphic to O(4)+O(5). Assume the weak relative-canonical normalization (N) fibrewise. Let 0->W_4->W->W_5->0 be the canonical filtered relations bundle, put L=W_5 tensor omega_{C/S}^{-1}, let B=Conf_6(C/S), let Gamma be its universal ordered divisor, and let phi:pi_{B*}W_B->pi_{B*}(W_B|Gamma) be the intrinsic evaluation map. Define Z=V(Fit_0(coker phi)) inside B, let AJ=Hilb^6(C/S) times_{Pic^6(C/S)} S, and let U be the distinct-support open of AJ. Then: (1) h^0(L_s)=3 and h^1(L_s)=2 for every geometric s, AJ is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle over S, and U->S is smooth, surjective, and purely of relative dimension two; (2) phi has ranks 26->12, every geometric fibre has rank 11 or 12, I_j(phi)=O_B for j<=11, and I_12(phi)=Fit_0(coker phi)=a_N^*I_e scheme-theoretically; (3) forgetting the ordering identifies Z canonically with the S_6-torsor Ord(U)->U, which is finite etale of degree 720, so Z->S is smooth and surjective of pure relative dimension two; (4) if S is of finite type, every irreducible component of Z and of U dominates an irreducible component of S and has dimension equal to the dimension of that component plus two; and (5) Z->B is a regular immersion of pure codimension four with locally free rank-four conormal sheaf. No assertion is made about the number of components, geometric monodromy, stabilizers, a morphism to M_{6,6}, or unbalanced Casnati-Ekedahl strata.
